pullRequest.title: test(scripts): plugin manifests exist, parse and carry a valid semver version (DEFAUL-860)
pullRequest.body:
Adds a test run by `pnpm test:scripts` that reads `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and fails when either is missing, unparsable, or has no valid semver `version`. An empty corpus (nothing checked) fails rather than passes, and the test prints `checked N manifests`.

Counterexamples seen RED: missing file, `{oops`, no version, `v1`, `1.0`, neutralized semver predicate, neutralized zero-checked guard.

Gates: format 0, lint 0, typecheck 0, test:scripts 0 (42 passed). Manifests unchanged.

Delivered by the Everdict Supervisor persona via a delegate sandbox.
